name: Cybersecurity
summary: The current shelf connects exploited-vulnerability deadlines, recurring federal asset visibility, AI and national-security infrastructure risk, and protocol-level post-quantum testing. It supports obligations and technical limits while agency compliance, non-federal adoption, incident reduction, and completed migration require separate records.
watch_questions: Which BOD 23-01 records demonstrate current asset coverage, scan cadence, ownership reconciliation, exceptions, and remediation?
Where do KEV deadlines, AI infrastructure, mobility, energy, space, finance, and post-quantum work become operational obligations?
Which institutions can prove inventory, patching, procurement, incident response, validation, and migration progress with audit-ready records?
